activities.name: Kathakali performance
activities.blurb: Classical dance-drama at a small Fort Kochi theatre; come early to watch the make-up.

activities.name: Sunset harbour cruise
activities.blurb: An hour on the harbour, past the Chinese fishing nets as the light goes.

activities.name: Fort Kochi heritage walk
activities.blurb: A guided walk through the Dutch Palace lanes, old churches and spice warehouses.

activities.name: Kerala home cooking class
activities.blurb: Cook and share a Kerala dinner with a family in Mattancherry.

activities.name: Tea museum & factory visit
activities.blurb: See leaf turn into tea at a working factory, then taste the estate’s grades.

activities.name: Eravikulam National Park
activities.blurb: Park shuttle and entry to the Nilgiri tahr grasslands.

activities.name: Sunrise jeep & trek, Kolukkumalai
activities.warn: Weather-dependent; the operator confirms the day before.
activities.blurb: A jeep up to Kolukkumalai for sunrise over the tea estates, then a guided trek.

activities.name: Cardamom estate walk
activities.blurb: A planter walks you through cardamom, pepper and coffee growing under shade trees.

activities.name: Chinese fishing nets at dawn
activities.blurb: Help the fishermen haul the giant cantilevered nets, then breakfast on the beach.

activities.name: Jew Town spice market trail
activities.blurb: Taste pepper, cardamom and cinnamon with a local guide, ending at the Paradesi synagogue.

activities.name: Mattupetty dam & echo point
activities.blurb: A drive up to the lake for a short boat ride and a walk to the echo point.

activities.name: Ayurvedic massage
activities.blurb: A 75-minute abhyanga oil massage for two at a certified centre near town.

activities.name: Toddy shop lunch
activities.blurb: Karimeen fry, tapioca and fish curry at a canal-side toddy shop, reached by boat.

activities.name: Sunset shikara ride
activities.blurb: A covered shikara out to Vembanad Lake to watch the sun go down over the paddy fields.

activities.name: Village canoe ride
activities.blurb: A narrow canoe through village canals too small for the houseboats.
